summary: The PR corrects a misleading hint in the error message for recursive relationships, but it does not address the underlying issue of the error itself.

issues.description: The PR only changes the hint in the error message, but it does not address the root cause of the error. The error still occurs when there are more than two ForeignKeys in an intermediary model without setting through_fields.
The PR does not include any tests to verify that the corrected hint is displayed correctly. It also does not include tests to ensure that the error is resolved.
